summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 6, 2026, reporting third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. FFO was $717 million, or $0.91 per unit, up 10% year over year, with net income of $69 million versus $440 million a year earlier, the decline attributed to prior-year asset-sale gains. Management cited organic growth, roughly $1.4 billion of commissioned backlog projects and a pipeline of acquisition and capital-partnership opportunities. No transaction, price, stake or board recommendation is stated; routine earnings disclosure only.
